title: Every declaration of the Spacelift Flows app SDK
description: Generated by specref inventory --product flows from api/reference/spacelift-flows/sdk-identifiers.json, the identifiers of @slflows/sdk's declaration file. One record per declaration, its id the declared name, ordered by name. The SDK declares no licence, so only names are kept: no types, comments or code.

package.description: The npm package the identifiers come from.

exported.description: True when the package exports the declaration.

members.description: The member names of an interface, or of a const declared with an object type.

optional.description: True when the member is declared with ?.
